title: Mleccha Slayer
author: Kshatriya Strength
desc: This comprehensive six-day push-pull-legs mesocycle is meticulously crafted to maximize hypertrophy. Each session targets specific muscle groups with a blend of compound and isolation movements, ensuring balanced development.
